requirements.question: Describe how customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
requirements.answer: Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 using keys managed in AWS KMS, and all data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.2 or higher.

requirements.question: Describe your backup and disaster-recovery arrangements, including RPO and RTO.

requirements.question: Describe your implementation approach and a typical timeline.
requirements.answer: A typical implementation takes 6 to 8 weeks and is led by a dedicated Larkspur implementation manager. Implementation follows four phases: discovery (weeks 1-2), configuration and data connection (weeks 3-5), user acceptance testing (week 6), and go-live with hypercare (weeks 7-8).
